items.html: And after its departure from within him, the Supernal Ima spreads in the aspect of her NNH within the Nukva herself; and those Gevurot of the side of Gevura are drawn to her by means of Bina, not by means of ZA. And as this is stated well in the blessing "Hamaplil" (Who causes the bands of sleep to fall), etc. — see there well. And it will also be explained below, in the matter of the intention of the Shofar, for there is explained the matter of what departed from ZA, namely Bina and the side of Gevura, to enter the head of the Nukva; but the moach of Hochma and the side of Hesed remained in the aspect of Makifim upon the head of ZA.
